name: personalize
description: Amazon Personalize is a machine learning service that makes it easy to add individualized recommendations to customers.

subcommands.name: create-batch-inference-job
subcommands.description: Generates batch recommendations based on a list of items or users stored in Amazon S3 and exports the recommendations to an Amazon S3 bucket.

subcommands.name: create-batch-segment-job
subcommands.description: Creates a batch segment job.

subcommands.name: create-campaign
subcommands.description: You incur campaign costs while it is active.

subcommands.name: create-data-deletion-job
subcommands.description: Creates a batch job that deletes all references to specific users from an Amazon Personalize dataset group in batches.

subcommands.name: create-dataset
subcommands.description: Creates an empty dataset and adds it to the specified dataset group.

subcommands.name: create-dataset-export-job
subcommands.description: Creates a job that exports data from your dataset to an Amazon S3 bucket.

subcommands.name: create-dataset-group
subcommands.description: Creates an empty dataset group.

subcommands.name: create-dataset-import-job
subcommands.description: Creates a job that imports training data from your data source (an Amazon S3 bucket) to an Amazon Personalize dataset.

subcommands.name: create-event-tracker
subcommands.description: Creates an event tracker that you use when adding event data to a specified dataset group using the PutEvents API.

subcommands.name: create-filter
subcommands.description: Creates a recommendation filter.

subcommands.name: create-metric-attribution
subcommands.description: Creates a metric attribution.

subcommands.name: create-recommender
subcommands.description: Creates a recommender with the recipe (a Domain dataset group use case) you specify.

subcommands.name: create-schema
subcommands.description: Creates an Amazon Personalize schema from the specified schema string.

subcommands.name: create-solution
subcommands.description: By default, all new solutions use automatic training.

subcommands.name: create-solution-version
subcommands.description: Trains or retrains an active solution in a Custom dataset group.

subcommands.name: delete-campaign
subcommands.description: Removes a campaign by deleting the solution deployment.

subcommands.name: delete-dataset
subcommands.description: Deletes a dataset.

subcommands.name: delete-dataset-group
subcommands.description: Deletes a dataset group.

subcommands.name: delete-event-tracker
subcommands.description: Deletes the event tracker.

subcommands.name: delete-filter
subcommands.description: Deletes a filter.

subcommands.name: delete-metric-attribution
subcommands.description: Deletes a metric attribution.

subcommands.name: delete-recommender
subcommands.description: Deactivates and removes a recommender.

subcommands.name: delete-schema
subcommands.description: Deletes a schema.

subcommands.name: delete-solution
subcommands.description: Deletes all versions of a solution and the Solution object itself.

subcommands.name: describe-algorithm
subcommands.description: Describes the given algorithm.

subcommands.name: describe-batch-inference-job
subcommands.description: Gets the properties of a batch inference job including name, Amazon Resource Name (ARN), status, input and output configurations, and the ARN of the solution version used to generate the recommendations.

subcommands.name: describe-batch-segment-job
subcommands.description: Gets the properties of a batch segment job including name, Amazon Resource Name (ARN), status, input and output configurations, and the ARN of the solution version used to generate segments.

subcommands.name: describe-campaign
subcommands.description: Describes the given campaign, including its status.

subcommands.name: describe-data-deletion-job
subcommands.description: Describes the data deletion job created by CreateDataDeletionJob, including the job status.

subcommands.name: describe-dataset
subcommands.description: Describes the given dataset.

subcommands.name: describe-dataset-export-job
subcommands.description: Describes the dataset export job created by CreateDatasetExportJob, including the export job status.

subcommands.name: describe-dataset-group
subcommands.description: Describes the given dataset group.

subcommands.name: describe-dataset-import-job
subcommands.description: Describes the dataset import job created by CreateDatasetImportJob, including the import job status.

subcommands.name: describe-event-tracker
subcommands.description: Describes an event tracker.

subcommands.name: describe-feature-transformation
subcommands.description: Describes the given feature transformation.

subcommands.name: describe-filter
subcommands.description: Describes a filter's properties.

subcommands.name: describe-metric-attribution
subcommands.description: Describes a metric attribution.

subcommands.name: describe-recipe
subcommands.description: Describes a recipe.

subcommands.name: describe-recommender
subcommands.description: Describes the given recommender, including its status.

subcommands.name: describe-schema
subcommands.description: Describes a schema.

subcommands.name: describe-solution
subcommands.description: Describes a solution.

subcommands.name: describe-solution-version
subcommands.description: Describes a specific version of a solution.

subcommands.name: get-solution-metrics
subcommands.description: Gets the metrics for the specified solution version.

subcommands.name: list-batch-inference-jobs
subcommands.description: Gets a list of the batch inference jobs that have been performed off of a solution version.

subcommands.name: list-batch-segment-jobs
subcommands.description: Gets a list of the batch segment jobs that have been performed off of a solution version that you specify.

subcommands.name: list-campaigns
subcommands.description: Returns a list of campaigns that use the given solution.

subcommands.name: list-data-deletion-jobs
subcommands.description: Returns a list of data deletion jobs for a dataset group ordered by creation time, with the most recent first.

subcommands.name: list-dataset-export-jobs
subcommands.description: Returns a list of dataset export jobs that use the given dataset.

subcommands.name: list-dataset-groups
subcommands.description: Returns a list of dataset groups.

subcommands.name: list-dataset-import-jobs
subcommands.description: Returns a list of dataset import jobs that use the given dataset.

subcommands.name: list-datasets
subcommands.description: Returns the list of datasets contained in the given dataset group.

subcommands.name: list-event-trackers
subcommands.description: Returns the list of event trackers associated with the account.

subcommands.name: list-filters
subcommands.description: Lists all filters that belong to a given dataset group.

subcommands.name: list-metric-attribution-metrics
subcommands.description: Lists the metrics for the metric attribution.

subcommands.name: list-metric-attributions
subcommands.description: Lists metric attributions.

subcommands.name: list-recipes
subcommands.description: Returns a list of available recipes.

subcommands.name: list-recommenders
subcommands.description: Returns a list of recommenders in a given Domain dataset group.

subcommands.name: list-schemas
subcommands.description: Returns the list of schemas associated with the account.

subcommands.name: list-solution-versions
subcommands.description: Returns a list of solution versions for the given solution.

subcommands.name: list-solutions
subcommands.description: Returns a list of solutions in a given dataset group.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Get a list of tags attached to a resource.

subcommands.name: start-recommender
subcommands.description: Starts a recommender that is INACTIVE.

subcommands.name: stop-recommender
subcommands.description: Stops a recommender that is ACTIVE.

subcommands.name: stop-solution-version-creation
subcommands.description: Stops creating a solution version that is in a state of CREATE_PENDING or CREATE IN_PROGRESS.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Add a list of tags to a resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes the specified tags that are attached to a resource.

subcommands.name: update-campaign
subcommands.description: Updates a campaign to deploy a retrained solution version with an existing campaign, change your campaign's minProvisionedTPS, or modify your campaign's configuration.

subcommands.name: update-dataset
subcommands.description: Update a dataset to replace its schema with a new or existing one.

subcommands.name: update-metric-attribution
subcommands.description: Updates a metric attribution.

subcommands.name: update-recommender
subcommands.description: Updates the recommender to modify the recommender configuration.

subcommands.name: update-solution
subcommands.description: Updates an Amazon Personalize solution to use a different automatic training configuration.
